new_records_needed: Aaron Flint (R); Sam Forstag (D); Nick Sheedy (L) -- NOTE-MT-1-RETIREMENT: incumbent Ryan Zinke announced March 2, 2026 he would not seek re-election (https://www.kulr8.com/elections/montana-congressman-ryan-zinke-to-retire-will-not-seek-reelection/article_ef317ebf-4a81-588a-975c-18e7515b9cbc.html) and endorsed R nominee Aaron Flint; Zinke is NOT on the 2026 ballot in any capacity. All 3 general candidates are new records -- none is the incumbent. Flint won the R primary (50.1%) and Forstag won the D primary (37.3%) on June 2, 2026. NOTE-MT-PETITION-STATUS: independent Kimberly Persico attempted ballot access via petition (6,742 signatures required) but unofficial county tallies as of the May 26, 2026 filing deadline showed only 562 accepted / 156 rejected -- far short of threshold (https://sosmt.gov/candidate-petition-signatures-submitted-to-montana-counties-election-officials-to-verify-and-certify); MT SOS final independent-candidacy certification (overall ballot certification deadline August 20, 2026) was still pending as of this resolution date (2026-07-03), so Persico is EXCLUDED from the confirmed field pending official action. Libertarian Nick Sheedy filed directly with FILED (not PENDING PETITION) status per candidatefiling.mt.gov -- MT Libertarian Party is a recognized minor party requiring no petition -- and is confirmed for the general ballot.
